summary: Three separate incidents on 4 Nov 2026. The most serious is a login with the amalik password to the VPN from Romania that reached the file server and moved about 2.4 GB out of it. Two other incidents are lower severity, and two events were closed as approved changes.

incidents.title: VPN login from Romania, 2.4 GB from the file server
incidents.severityWhy: Credential compromise reached SRV-FS01 (High), which is P2 [[03_severity_matrix.md#Credential compromise (account used by an attacker)]]. Data exfiltration from a High asset is P1 [[03_severity_matrix.md#Data exfiltration (large transfer, confirmed or suspected)]]. The incident takes the highest part (rule 4.2) [[01_company_security_rules.md#R4.2]].
incidents.summary: A phishing email reached three staff. A finance laptop then connected to the sender's address. About an hour and a half later the same address logged in to the VPN as amalik after four failed multi-factor attempts, reached the file server and database server, and pulled about 2.4 GB from the file server.

timeline.text: Phishing email M-55187 delivered to amalik, sraheel and utariq (spam score 6.2, SPF failed). [[16_email_gateway_log.md#L2]] [[16_email_gateway_log.md#L3]] [[16_email_gateway_log.md#L4]]
Four failed multi-factor attempts for amalik from 198.51.100.77 (Romania). [[11_vpn_auth_log.md#L3]] [[11_vpn_auth_log.md#L6]]
Login approved. Session VS-20433, address 10.10.3.45 assigned. [[11_vpn_auth_log.md#L7]] [[17_ids_alert_summary.md#ALT-9003]]
Kerberos ticket requests for amalik from 10.10.3.45, including the file server. [[12_windows_dc_auth_log.md#L3]] [[12_windows_dc_auth_log.md#L4]]
Service ticket for the database server, then a connection to it. [[12_windows_dc_auth_log.md#L5]] [[15_firewall_internal_log.md#L5]]

Large SMB session from SRV-FS01 to 10.10.3.45 starts (calculated: the log is written at close, 06:21:19 UTC, minus 1087 seconds). [[15_firewall_internal_log.md#L6]] [[17_ids_alert_summary.md#ALT-9005]]
amalik locked out after two bad-password logons on LT-FIN-014. [[12_windows_dc_auth_log.md#L7]] [[12_windows_dc_auth_log.md#L9]] [[17_ids_alert_summary.md#ALT-9008]]

path.label: Connection to the phishing host (click suspected)
VPN login after failed multi-factor attempts

confirmed.text: 198.51.100.77 failed multi-factor for amalik three times by denial and once by timeout, then was approved as session VS-20433 with address 10.10.3.45. [[11_vpn_auth_log.md#L3]] [[11_vpn_auth_log.md#L7]]
Address 10.10.3.45 received Kerberos tickets for the file server and the database server. [[12_windows_dc_auth_log.md#L4]] [[12_windows_dc_auth_log.md#L5]]
About 2.41 GB moved from SRV-FS01 to 10.10.3.45, matching the 2.42 GB the VPN session received. [[15_firewall_internal_log.md#L6]] [[11_vpn_auth_log.md#L8]]
The amalik password was reset from 10.10.3.45. [[12_windows_dc_auth_log.md#L6]]

suspected.text: amalik opened the link in the payroll email on LT-FIN-014.
suspected.assumption: The 04:19:40 UTC connection to 198.51.100.77 was caused by the link in M-55187. The logs show the connection, not the click. [[14_firewall_perimeter_log.md#L8]] [[17_ids_alert_summary.md#ALT-9002]]

suspected.text: The VPN password came from the fake payroll page.
suspected.assumption: The password was typed on that page. No log shows what was typed.

insufficient.text: Which files were read from SRV-FS01. No file access log is collected for that server.
Whether the database was queried. Only a short connection is logged. [[15_firewall_internal_log.md#L5]]

actions.text: Call the real user on the number in the user directory.
Disable the account and end all active VPN sessions.
Block the transfer destination and keep the evidence. Do not reboot SRV-FS01.
Record that it is unknown which files were read.

inform.how: Email and phone, finance and HR data may be involved

incidents.title: SQL injection against the public web server
incidents.severityWhy: Web application attack, success suspected, on SRV-WEB01 (Medium) is P2. [[03_severity_matrix.md#Web application attack, success suspected or confirmed]]
incidents.summary: 192.0.2.150 ran sqlmap against the order search page. Most requests returned errors, but one request returned a large 200 response.

timeline.text: First sqlmap request to the order search page, answered with 500. [[13_web_server_log.md#L6]] [[17_ids_alert_summary.md#ALT-9004]]
A UNION SELECT request is answered with 200 and 48,213 bytes. [[13_web_server_log.md#L9]]

confirmed.text: Five requests with the sqlmap user agent hit the order search page. Four got 500 and one got 200 with 48,213 bytes. [[13_web_server_log.md#L6]] [[13_web_server_log.md#L9]]

suspected.text: The 200 response carried data from the users table.
suspected.assumption: A large 200 reply to a UNION SELECT request means the query ran. The log does not show the response body.

insufficient.text: Whether the database server saw matching queries. Its logs are not forwarded to the SOC.

actions.text: Ask the web team to review the code of the attacked page.

incidents.title: Port scan and probing from outside
incidents.severityWhy: Unapproved scanning against SRV-WEB01 (Medium) is P4. [[03_severity_matrix.md#Unapproved scanning or reconnaissance]]
incidents.summary: 192.0.2.88 tried six ports on the web server: five were denied and port 443 was allowed. It then probed for admin pages that do not exist.

timeline.text: Five connection attempts to ports 22, 23, 3389, 445 and 8080 are denied. [[14_firewall_perimeter_log.md#L1]] [[14_firewall_perimeter_log.md#L5]] [[17_ids_alert_summary.md#ALT-9001]]

confirmed.text: Five ports were refused and only port 443 was allowed. [[14_firewall_perimeter_log.md#L6]]

actions.text: Watch the source for the next 24 hours.
